zh-TW: 忙的時候我會先找哪個交接最容易卡住，再安排人力。
en: When things get busy, I look for handovers that might get stuck before arranging the team.

zh-TW: 辦活動時先畫出參加者從報到到離開的路線，我常在那張圖上發現漏掉的事。
en: Before an event, I sketch the visitor's journey from arrival to departure. That often reveals something I have missed.

zh-TW: 我會把專案週會改成只問三件事：完成了什麼、卡在哪裡、誰來幫。
en: I keep weekly project meetings to three questions: What is done, what is stuck, and who can help?

zh-TW: 想試手沖，可以用同一款豆子調整一個變數，再比較兩杯。
en: Try brewing the same beans while changing just one thing, then compare the two cups.

zh-TW: 流程轉型前我先請同事做一次給我看，實際做法常和流程圖不同。
en: Before redesigning a process, I ask someone to show me how they really do it. It often differs from the diagram.

zh-TW: 我喜歡先看攤主怎麼介紹產品，再決定哪幾攤放在一起。
en: I like watching how stallholders introduce their products before deciding which stalls belong together.

zh-TW: 做策略時我會問，這個選擇代表我們願意放掉什麼。
en: When discussing strategy, I ask what we are willing to give up by making this choice.

zh-TW: 收到模糊的題目時，我會問客戶最後需要做哪一個決定。
en: When a brief is unclear, I ask what decision the client ultimately needs to make.

zh-TW: 團隊一直出現同一個問題時，我會先看主管獎勵了哪些行為。
en: When a team keeps running into the same problem, I look at which behaviours are being rewarded.

zh-TW: 我會找三位使用者示範卡住的地方，再決定要改哪一步。
en: I ask three people to show me where they get stuck before choosing what to improve.

zh-TW: 轉做顧問時，我把一個預算案整理成問題、證據和最後做的決定。
en: When moving into consulting, I turned a budgeting project into a story about the question, the evidence, and the decision.

zh-TW: 我會先在一個願意嘗試的部門測流程，再請他們自己分享成果。
en: I test a process with a willing team first, then let them share what they learned.

zh-TW: 經營社群時，我最想知道的是參加者會不會自己約下一次見面。
en: For me, a healthy community is one where people start arranging their next gathering themselves.

zh-TW: 做科技試點時，我先訪談最常處理例外的同事，再挑一小段流程來測。
en: Before a technology pilot, I speak to the people who handle exceptions, then choose one small process to test.

zh-TW: 我做品牌定位時會問客人，什麼情境下會第一個想到你。
en: I ask customers in which moment they would think of a brand first.

zh-TW: 我常請創業者先找五個真的遇到痛點的人，聽他們現在怎麼解決。
en: I encourage founders to meet five people who truly face the problem and listen to how they handle it now.

zh-TW: 第一次去創業聚會，可以問對方最近推翻了哪個假設。
en: At your first startup gathering, ask someone which assumption they have recently changed their mind about.

zh-TW: 測試菜單時我先賣一個品項，確認客人願不願意回來再買。
en: When testing a menu, I start with one item and see whether people want to come back for it.

zh-TW: 看損益時我會先把量、價格和產品組合拆開，再解釋主要差異。
en: I separate volume, price, and product mix before explaining the main changes in profit.

zh-TW: 做消費品訪談時，我喜歡請顧客回想最近一次購買，而不是問平常偏好。
en: In customer interviews, I ask about the last purchase rather than general preferences.

zh-TW: 看一筆併購案時，我會列出三個買下之後才能做到的事。
en: When looking at an acquisition, I list three things that would only become possible after it.

zh-TW: 拆個案時先說哪一個新證據會讓你改變立場。
en: Start a case discussion by saying which new piece of evidence would change your mind.

zh-TW: 討論卡住時，我會請每個人說出自己最在意的一個限制。
en: When a discussion gets stuck, I ask each person to name the constraint that matters most to them.

zh-TW: 選技術方向時，我會先找出哪個測試能最快排除錯誤假設。
en: When choosing a technology direction, I look for the quickest test that could rule out a mistaken assumption.

zh-TW: 我會把永續指標接到採購決策，才看得出實際影響。
en: Sustainability measures become useful when I connect them to purchasing decisions.

zh-TW: 我練口說時會錄下 45 秒答案，只重聽開頭和最後一句。
en: I record a 45-second speaking answer and listen again only to the beginning and the final sentence.

zh-TW: 開會想打斷時可以先說 Could I add one point here
en: To join a meeting discussion, try saying Could I add one point here
and follow it with one clear point.

zh-TW: 跨文化會議快結束時，我會請大家用自己的話重述下一步。
en: At the end of an international meeting, I ask everyone to describe the next step in their own words.

zh-TW: 英文簡報第一句，我會直接說我希望聽眾做什麼決定。
en: I open an English presentation by saying what decision I hope the audience will make.

zh-TW: 簡報一頁只有一個訊息時，聽的人才知道該看哪個數字。
en: One message per slide helps people know which number to focus on.

zh-TW: 跨國品牌活動前，我會請當地同事講一次他們平常怎麼向朋友描述產品。
en: Before a campaign abroad, I ask local colleagues how they would describe the product to a friend.

zh-TW: 試做運動產品時，我喜歡觀察大家拿了裝備之後，第一件事是什麼。
en: When testing sports equipment, I watch what people do first after picking it up.

zh-TW: 揪球友時我會先把程度、費用和集合點寫清楚。
en: When inviting people to play, I make the level, cost, and meeting point clear first.

zh-TW: 給久坐的人，我喜歡先安排十分鐘能完成的輕量活動。
en: For people who sit all day, I like starting with something gentle they can finish in ten minutes.

zh-TW: 第一次打匹克球，可以先練發球和接球，再進雙打。
en: For your first pickleball session, practise serving and returning before trying doubles.

zh-TW: 在練習場我會用同一支鐵桿打兩組半揮桿，先看擊球位置。
en: At the range, I use one iron for two sets of half swings and focus on where the club meets the ball.

zh-TW: 做體育行銷時，我會把第一次參加和願意再來分開看。
en: I look separately at a first visit and the decision to come back when reviewing sports marketing.

zh-TW: 和投資人聊績效時，我習慣先分開一次性因素與經常性表現。
en: When discussing performance with investors, I separate one-off effects from recurring results.

zh-TW: 拆成長時我會先看營收有沒有同步轉成現金。
en: When examining growth, I look at whether revenue is turning into cash too.

zh-TW: 看早期創業案時，我會追問第一批客人為什麼留下來。
en: For an early startup, I ask why its first customers chose to stay.

zh-TW: 談融資前我會先列出這筆錢要支應的三件事和各自期限。
en: Before raising funds, I list the three things the money will support and their deadlines.

zh-TW: 做估值敏感度分析時，我先測最容易讓結論翻轉的假設。
en: For valuation sensitivities, I first test the assumption most likely to change the conclusion.

zh-TW: 企業投資新創時，我會問哪個業務團隊願意一起把合作做下去。
en: When a company invests in a startup, I ask which business team wants to help the partnership grow.

zh-TW: 精品店做陳列時，我會先站到客人進門的位置，看看第一眼落在哪裡。
en: When arranging a store, I stand where a customer enters and notice where my eyes go first.

zh-TW: 到一個新城市，我常從當地市場走到住宅街，記下兩邊的差異。
en: In a new city, I walk from the local market into a residential street and note what changes.

zh-TW: 看國際市場時，我會先問一個原本合理的商業假設到了當地還成立嗎。
en: For a new market, I ask whether an assumption that made sense at home still holds there.

zh-TW: 第一次露營，我會先練一次收帳篷，再把早晚要穿的衣服分開。
en: Before a first camping trip, I practise packing the tent and separate my morning and evening clothes.

zh-TW: 拍旅行照時，我會用同一個角度各拍有人和沒人的版本。
en: I take the same travel scene with and without people from one viewpoint.

zh-TW: 做旅宿體驗時，我會從客人抵達的前十分鐘找能改善的小事。
en: I look for small ways to improve a guest's first ten minutes after arriving.

zh-TW: 自然休憩區 · 海岸花園
花園、木棧道與面海長椅。今天不用帶著任何心事，也可以只是來看海。
en: A garden, a boardwalk, and a bench facing the sea. You do not need a reason to come and watch the water.

zh-TW: 海風很輕，沿著木棧道慢慢走。
en: The breeze is gentle. Take your time along the boardwalk.

zh-TW: 想找一個更安靜的角落？
如果今天想整理心情，原本的傷心之島仍在。
en: If you would like a moment with your feelings, Quiet Island is still here.

zh-TW: 留一個角落，給不用努力的自己。
en: A little corner where you can simply be.

zh-TW: 是一座為成年人創作的小小渡假村。在現實生活裡，我們常常忙著工作、回覆訊息、追趕進度；這裡想留下一點空白，讓人可以只是待著。
en: is a little seaside retreat for grown-ups. Outside this world, we work, reply to messages, and keep up. Here, there is a little room to breathe and simply stay awhile.

zh-TW: 沿著海岸，給自己留一點空白。
en: A little space for yourself, along the coast.

zh-TW: 有自己的家，也有可以走走的世界
en: A home of your own, and a world to wander

zh-TW: 我想創作的，是「成年人的心靈寄託小宇宙」。小屋收藏你的喜好，海岸接住短暫的疲倦；即使只來五分鐘，也能找到一件單純喜歡的小事。回小屋整理喜歡的角落，出門喝杯咖啡、推一顆球，或在海邊遇見正在散步的動物居民。每個小動作，都可以只是因為喜歡。
en: I imagine a little universe of comfort for grown-ups. Your cottage holds the things you love, and the coast offers a pause when you feel tired. Even five minutes can hold one small, lovely moment. Arrange a favourite corner, head out for coffee, roll a golf ball across the green, or pass an animal neighbour on a walk. Do it simply because you feel like it.

zh-TW: 朋友是陪伴，自在是前提
en: Company, with room to be yourself

zh-TW: 你可以邀朋友來坐，也可以獨自看海。不需要天天報到，不需要比成績，更不需要為了跟上誰而留下。
en: Invite a friend to sit with you, or watch the sea alone. There is no need to check in every day, compare scores, or keep up with anyone.

zh-TW: 童趣，也是大人可以擁有的日常
en: A little playfulness belongs in adult life, too

zh-TW: 熊熊渡假村想保留柔軟、好奇與玩心。希望你離開時，帶走一點舒服，而不是多一張待辦清單。
en: Bear Atlas makes room for softness, curiosity, and play. I hope you leave a little more at ease, without another to-do list to carry.
A coastline with no reason to hurry.
A moment to let the day slow down.

zh-TW: 把生活的節奏，還給自己
早晨在咖啡街選一杯熱飲，午後到運動俱樂部動一動，傍晚沿著花園慢慢走回家。這些安排沒有標準順序，也沒有必須完成的清單。今天的你，決定今天的步調。
en: Choose a warm drink in the morning, move a little at the sports club in the afternoon, and wander home through the garden at dusk. There is no set order and nothing you have to finish. You choose the pace.

zh-TW: 不是為了追上誰，單純享受身體動起來的感覺。
en: Enjoy moving, at your own pace.

zh-TW: 一座慢慢長大的小世界
從一間小屋、一段海岸，到動物居民散步的小鎮，Bear Atlas 會一點點長大。我希望每一次增加的細節，都讓這裡更容易親近：看得懂的路、可以坐下的椅子，以及隨時能回去的家。
en: From a cottage and a stretch of coast to a town of wandering neighbours, Bear Atlas will grow a little at a time. Each detail should make it easier to feel at home: clear paths, chairs to rest on, and a home to return to.

zh-TW: 願這裡成為你偶爾想回來的地方。你可以熱鬧，也可以安靜；不必交代理由，只要舒服地待著。
en: May this be a place you sometimes feel like returning to. Be sociable or be quiet. You do not need a reason to stay.

zh-TW: 後來有什麼改變」講一遍。最後補上一個可以驗證的結果。

en: Try asking what surprised them when they entered their field, then ask for one example.

zh-TW: 每人每天可放出 1 瓶，放出與接續合計最多 3 次。同一瓶，每位島民只能留一句。
en: Send one new bottle each day, with up to three sends or replies in total. Leave only one line in each bottle.

zh-TW: 你還沒有參與過漂流瓶故事。從一句話開始就好。
en: No bottle stories yet. One little line is enough to begin.

zh-TW: 認識願意在廣場亮相的熊熊。
en: Meet neighbours who have chosen to appear in the square.
No neighbours on this page yet.

zh-TW: 僅已登入的島民可看見你分享的熊熊造型、暱稱與島民編號。
en: Only signed-in residents can see the look, nickname, and resident ID you share here.

zh-TW: 請填寫活動名稱、類別、集合地點和人數上限。
en: Add an activity name, category, meeting point, and group limit.

zh-TW: 請選擇未來 90 天內的日期和時間（台灣時間）。
en: Choose a date and time within the next 90 days, in Taiwan time.

zh-TW: 只有發起人可以修改這個揪團。
en: Only the host can edit this gathering.

zh-TW: 請重新開啟編輯表單再試一次。
en: Reopen the edit form and try again.

zh-TW: 活動已變更、取消或開始，或人數上限小於目前團員數。請重新開啟編輯表單。
en: The gathering changed, was cancelled, or has started. The limit may also be below the current group size. Reopen the edit form.

zh-TW: 這份開團表單已使用過，請重新開啟表單。
en: This form has already been used. Open a fresh gathering form.
What Would You Like to Do?

zh-TW: 例如 週六來打匹克球雙打
例如 信義運動中心大門
en: For example, the main entrance of the sports centre
Level, cost, or things to bring

zh-TW: 已登入的島民可看到活動內容和你的暱稱，發起人可看到報名者的暱稱與島民編號。修改後請和團員確認新的安排。
en: Signed-in residents can see the activity and your nickname. Hosts can see participants' nicknames and resident IDs. Check any changed plans with your group.

zh-TW: 取消後，已報名的團員會看到取消狀態。
en: People who joined will see that the gathering is cancelled.

zh-TW: 挑一場有空的活動，或發起你想做的事。
en: Join something that suits your day, or invite others to do something you love.

zh-TW: 已帶入輪盤抽到的活動，補上時間與地點就能開團。
en: Your wheel idea is filled in. Add a time and place to get together.
You Have Not Joined a Gathering Yet

zh-TW: 你的第一團，從這裡開始
目前還沒有即將出發的團
從輪盤挑一個點子，或按「我要開團」約大家一起。
en: Spin for an idea, or host a gathering of your own.

zh-TW: 這個揪團已額滿、已截止，或你沒有權限進行這項操作。
en: This gathering is full, closed, or unavailable with your current permissions.

zh-TW: 請選擇一項有效的島民活動。
活動已取消或開始，無法再修改。
en: This activity is cancelled or has started and cannot be edited.

zh-TW: 這份輪盤結果無法讀取，請用原本的島民證登入或重新轉一次。
en: This wheel result could not load. Sign in with your original resident passport or spin again.

zh-TW: 認識島上的熊熊，找一團想去的活動。
en: Meet your neighbours and find a gathering you would enjoy.

zh-TW: 還沒有人打招呼。可以從你開始。
en: No greetings yet. Yours could be the first.

zh-TW: 發佈後，你的熊熊和暱稱會顯示給已登島的島民。你可以隨時撤下。
en: Your character and nickname will be visible to signed-in residents. You can remove the greeting anytime.

zh-TW: 起，可自由加入、各自找時間完成。
en: onward, join freely and take part whenever you have time.

zh-TW: 先登入島民證，這次的活動才會記進你的護照。
en: Sign in first to keep this activity in your passport.
Sign In with My Resident Passport

zh-TW: 今天有什麼小事，讓你想分享給對方？
en: What little thing happened today that you would like to share?

zh-TW: 如果今天是一種顏色，那會是什麼？
en: If today were a colour, what would it be?

zh-TW: 今天你給了自己什麼小獎勵？
en: What little treat did you give yourself today?

zh-TW: 去跳一堂 Swing 社交舞
挑有零基礎體驗的場次，先去跳三首歌。
en: Choose a beginner session and start with three songs.

zh-TW: 約 2–4 人打一小時。先說好是輕鬆練球還是打雙打。
en: Invite two to four people for an hour. Decide whether to practise gently or play doubles.

zh-TW: 逛一間沒去過的小酒館
en: Try a Little Bistro Somewhere New

zh-TW: 挑一杯有興趣的無酒精特調，坐吧台吃一道小菜。
en: Choose an interesting alcohol-free drink and enjoy a small dish at the counter.

zh-TW: 來一場 30 分鐘夜間攝影
en: Take a Thirty-minute Night Photo Walk

zh-TW: 選一條老街，拍三張有招牌、倒影或街燈的照片。
en: Choose an old street and photograph three signs, reflections, or streetlights.

zh-TW: 相約試一門下班手作課
en: Try an After-work Craft Class Together

zh-TW: 找一場有位子的陶作、調香或花藝課。
en: Look for a pottery, fragrance, or flower workshop with space available.
Play a Board Game for Two

zh-TW: 選一款 30 分鐘內能玩完的遊戲，輸家挑下次的店。
en: Choose a game that takes under thirty minutes. Let the loser pick the next café.

zh-TW: 看展後互選一件想帶回家的作品
en: Choose an Artwork for Each Other After an Exhibition

zh-TW: 各挑一件作品，到附近咖啡店聊為什麼。
en: Pick one work each, then share why over coffee nearby.

zh-TW: 揪一場新手高爾夫練球
到練習場各打一籃球，再互拍一段揮桿。
en: Hit a basket of balls each at the range, then film a swing for each other.

zh-TW: 抽一站捷運，來一趟半日旅行
en: Pick a Metro Stop for a Half-day Adventure

zh-TW: 走一條平常不會走的巷子，找間店吃午餐。
en: Walk down an unfamiliar lane and find somewhere for lunch.

zh-TW: 去傳統市場挑三樣食材做午餐
en: Choose Three Market Ingredients for Lunch

zh-TW: 每人選一樣，回家一起做一道從沒做過的菜。
en: Pick one ingredient each and cook something you have never made before.

zh-TW: 報名一堂陌生舞種的體驗課
從爵士舞、現代舞或即興律動選一個去跳。
en: Choose jazz, contemporary dance, or improvisation and give it a go.
Try a Three-game Table Tennis Challenge

zh-TW: 找球館打三局，再交換一個對方最難接的球。
en: Play three games, then share the shot you found hardest to return.

zh-TW: 榕樹廣場 · 發佈招呼
雙人任務 · 明信片已揭曉
這裡只有你看得到。逛頁面或翻護照不會留下紀錄；更新回答或投票會顯示最新內容。
en: Only you can see this. Browsing pages or your passport leaves no activity record. Updates to answers and votes show the latest version.

zh-TW: 今晚想換個花樣，還是週末想約人出去？選一個時段再轉。
en: Something different after work, or a weekend adventure with a friend? Choose a time and give it a spin.
Host a Gathering with This Idea

zh-TW: 挑一道題，把連結傳給一個朋友。兩個人各寫一句話，等雙方都交件後一起揭曉。
en: Choose a question and send the link to a friend. Leave one line each, then reveal them together when both are ready.

zh-TW: 回護照找我參加的任務 ↗
en: Find My Activities in My Passport ↗

zh-TW: 連結可能無效，或兩個位子都有人了。
en: The link may be invalid, or both places are already taken.
Someone Has Already Accepted This Invitation

zh-TW: 請向朋友索取另一張邀請。
en: Ask your friend for a new invitation.

zh-TW: 請寫下 1 到 240 個字元。
這次操作沒有送出，請確認任務狀態。
en: Your action was not sent. Check the activity's status.

zh-TW: 一位島民邀請你交換明信片。只有兩位參加者都交件後才會揭曉。
en: A neighbour has invited you to exchange postcards. They will open only when both of you have sent yours.

zh-TW: 把邀請連結傳給一位朋友
en: Send This Invitation to a Friend

zh-TW: 雙人揭曉章 · 兩張明信片都到了！
en: Paired Reveal Stamp · Both Postcards Are Here!

zh-TW: 你的明信片已封存，等對方交件後回來揭曉。
en: Your postcard is tucked away safely. Come back when your friend has sent theirs.

zh-TW: 登入原本的島民證，就能開啟朋友分享的運動邀約。
en: Sign in with your original resident passport to open a friend's sports invitation.

zh-TW: 認識島上的熊熊、自己開團找同伴，或轉輪盤決定下一站。
en: Meet the neighbours, host a gathering, or spin the wheel for your next stop.
Enter the Square with My Passport
Return to Sports Island & Try Again ↗
This invitation link is too long

zh-TW: 這不是熊熊港城的運動邀約連結，請貼上朋友傳來的完整網址。
en: This is not a Bear Atlas sports invitation. Paste the complete link your friend sent.

zh-TW: 到榕樹廣場找球伴或開團 ↗
en: Find a Partner or Host a Game in Banyan Square ↗

zh-TW: 收到朋友的揪團邀約了嗎？貼上他分享的連結，就能查看活動時間、地點和回覆。
en: Received an invitation? Paste your friend's link to see the time, place, and replies.

zh-TW: 你還沒有參加過旅行提案。收到朋友分享的提案連結後，可以直接去投票。
en: No travel proposals yet. When a friend shares a proposal link, you can visit it to vote.

zh-TW: 海軍藍西裝與奶油白長褲
選一套完整造型，儲存後會顯示在護照和私人島。
en: Choose a complete look. Save it to display it on your passport and private island.

zh-TW: 推開海景套房的陽台，就能看到船駛進灣內。從有拱廊的中庭出發，散步兩分鐘就到泳池。
en: Open the balcony of your sea-view suite and watch boats enter the cove. A two-minute walk from the arcaded courtyard brings you to the pool.

zh-TW: 泳池貼著海崖往外延伸。傍晚靠在池邊，水線和遠方的海平面會疊在一起。
en: The pool stretches toward the edge of the cliff. At dusk, its waterline meets the distant horizon.

zh-TW: 一段藏在礁石後的沙灘。沿著木棧道走下去，白色浪花會一層一層退回海裡。
en: A beach tucked behind the rocks. Follow the wooden boardwalk down and watch white waves slip back into the sea.

zh-TW: 小徑從海崖往林子裡彎，穿過蕨類和雪松。清晨來走，能看到樹影在地上晃。
en: The path turns from the cliffs into ferns and cedars. Come early and watch the tree shadows sway across the ground.

zh-TW: 把瑜伽墊攤在玻璃亭裡，門一推開就是森林。早上練流動，傍晚適合做一堂慢伸展。
en: Unroll a mat in the glass pavilion and open the door to the forest. Mornings welcome flowing movement; evenings invite a gentle stretch.

zh-TW: 白牆展廳面向潮水，以攝影、海岸地景與當代雕塑為主題。採光天井的光會慢慢移過展牆。
en: White galleries face the tides, with photography, coastal landscapes, and contemporary sculpture. Skylight slowly travels across the walls.

zh-TW: 從城堡下來會經過一排拱窗。店裡陳列洋裝、皮革手袋和旅行配件；晚上櫥窗亮起暖光。
en: A row of arched windows on the path from the castle. Dresses, leather bags, and travel treasures sit in warm window light after dusk.

zh-TW: 城堡坐在島的最高處，兩座圓塔之間有一座花園。天黑後走上露台，可以俯瞰海灣和燈火。
en: The castle rests on the highest hill, with a garden between its round towers. Its terrace looks out over the cove and evening lights.

zh-TW: 花園深處只留一張餐桌。主廚依季節換菜，想像今晚先喝一口清湯，再等爐火端上主菜。
en: A single table waits deep in the garden. The seasonal dinner begins with a clear broth, then a warm main dish from the fire.

zh-TW: 面海吧台只有六席。每日魚貨決定上菜順序，從清爽的白身魚，到最後一貫微炙的握壽司。
en: Just six seats face the sea. The day's catch guides dinner, from delicate white fish to a final lightly seared piece of sushi.

zh-TW: 翡翠灣：森林環抱著海崖飯店，城堡在山坡上，餐廳與沙灘面向海灣
en: Jade Cove: forest surrounds the clifftop hotel, a castle rests on the hill, and restaurants and beaches face the bay

zh-TW: 穿過拱門就到了大廳。窗外是翡翠灣，靠窗的沙發正好可以歇一下。
en: Beyond the arch is the lobby. Jade Cove fills the windows, and a sofa offers a little rest.

zh-TW: 站到池邊，就能看見水線和海平面接在一起。
en: At the edge of the pool, the waterline meets the sea.

zh-TW: 鞋尖碰到細沙，浪正從海灣一層層推過來。
en: Soft sand brushes your shoes as waves roll gently into the cove.

zh-TW: 轉過最後一棵雪松，林間小徑還在往山坡上延伸。
en: Beyond the last cedar, the woodland path keeps winding uphill.

zh-TW: 推開玻璃門，陽光落在攤好的瑜伽墊上。
en: Open the glass door. Sunlight falls across the waiting yoga mats.

zh-TW: 從採光天井落下來的光，正沿著白牆移動。
en: Light from the skylight drifts along a white wall.
Follow the Arcade to the Window

zh-TW: 一側是洋裝，另一側的玻璃櫃裡放著手袋。
en: Dresses line one side; handbags rest in glass cases on the other.

zh-TW: 從石拱門進來，再往上走就是能俯瞰整座海灣的露台。
en: Beyond the stone arch, steps lead to a terrace overlooking the cove.
Take a Seat at the Twilight Kitchen

zh-TW: 廚房裡傳出爐火聲，花園裡那張餐桌已經擺好。
en: A fire crackles in the kitchen. Your table is ready in the garden.
Take a Seat at Before the Tide Omakase

zh-TW: 潮師傅站在吧台後，今晚從紐西蘭生蠔開始。
en: Chef Chao is behind the counter. Tonight begins with New Zealand oysters.

zh-TW: 從生蠔開始。先嚐原味，感受海水的鮮甜。
en: Begin with an oyster, just as it is. Enjoy its gentle sweetness and taste of the sea.

zh-TW: 北海道水魚・赤海膽・小柱
en: Hokkaido Fish · Red Sea Urchin · Scallop

zh-TW: 水魚、赤海膽和小柱放在同一盤，三種口感可以分開嚐。
en: Three textures on one plate. Try the fish, sea urchin, and scallop separately.

zh-TW: 下一道是金目鯛，切片後把帶紅的魚皮朝上擺。
en: Next is golden-eye snapper, sliced with its red skin facing upward.

zh-TW: 這一盤是獅魚。先吃魚肉，感受它和金目鯛的差異。
en: Try the amberjack and notice how it differs from the snapper.

zh-TW: 台灣野生蛤蜊・乾燥蓮藕・真丈
en: Taiwanese Clam · Dried Lotus Root · Fish Dumpling

zh-TW: 蛤蜊、乾燥蓮藕和真丈，趁湯還熱先喝一口。
en: Clam, dried lotus root, and a fish dumpling. Take a sip while the broth is warm.

zh-TW: 酥麵墊底，鮑魚放在上面。一口一起吃，就能吃到兩種口感。
en: Abalone rests on crisp noodles. Try them together for two contrasting textures.

zh-TW: 握壽司前最後一道熱菜，是北寄貝茶碗蒸。
en: A warm surf clam egg custard before the sushi begins.

zh-TW: 接下來進入握壽司。第一貫是軟絲。
en: Now for the nigiri. The first piece is squid.
The sushi rice is a little dry.

zh-TW: 第二貫是九州真鯛。可以留意魚肉的清甜。
en: The second piece is Kyushu sea bream. Notice its delicate sweetness.
Fresh fish; the sushi rice is a little dry.

zh-TW: 同樣是北寄貝，這回用握壽司的方式上桌。
en: Surf clam returns, this time as nigiri.
The rice is still a little firm.

zh-TW: 獅魚肚上放一點柚子胡椒鹽，這一貫直接吃就好。
en: A little yuzu pepper salt tops the amberjack belly. Enjoy this piece as served.

zh-TW: 松葉蟹和赤海膽放進烤過的海苔，趁剛上桌吃。
en: Snow crab and red sea urchin in toasted seaweed. Enjoy it straight away.

zh-TW: 海苔有烤過，但沒有很脆。
en: The seaweed is toasted, though not very crisp.

zh-TW: 下一貫是白鰭魚。這一口先留意魚肉的質地。
en: For this piece, notice the texture of the fish first.

zh-TW: 來試午魚，可以跟前面那貫真鯛比比看。
en: Try the threadfin and compare it with the earlier sea bream.
The texture is a little like sea bream.

zh-TW: 這貫是白鯧魚肚，挑的是魚腹的部位。
en: This piece uses the tender belly of silver pomfret.

zh-TW: 黑鮪魚大腹・熟成第九天
en: Bluefin Tuna Belly · Aged Nine Days

zh-TW: 這貫是熟成第九天的黑鮪魚大腹，讓油脂的香氣慢慢出來。
en: Nine-day-aged bluefin tuna belly. Let its rich flavour unfold slowly.

zh-TW: 醋飯再濕潤一點會更好。
en: A little more moisture in the rice would be lovely.

zh-TW: 鰻魚手捲包好了，從海苔開口那一頭開始吃。
en: Your eel hand roll is ready. Begin at the open end of the seaweed.

zh-TW: 接下來是玉子燒。這塊很柔軟，可以慢慢吃。
en: Next is a soft piece of tamagoyaki. Take your time.

zh-TW: 立麟燒剛從火上拿下來，先看看魚皮，再趁熱吃。
en: Fresh from the heat. Notice the crisp skin, then enjoy it while warm.

zh-TW: 先喝碗味噌湯，讓味道停一下。
en: A bowl of miso soup offers a gentle pause.
This conger eel is a little gift from the chef.

zh-TW: 最後是甜點。謝謝你坐到最後一道。
en: Dessert is here. Thank you for staying to the final course.

zh-TW: 是 Kitty 標記的亮點；試吃筆記保留原本的口感觀察。
en: marks Kitty's favourites. Tasting notes keep her original observations.

zh-TW: 熊熊沿著池梯下水，水波在身邊散開。
en: Your little friend steps down the pool ladder as ripples spread around them.

zh-TW: 從池邊看過去，水面和遠方的海平線連在一起。
en: From the edge, the pool meets the distant sea.

zh-TW: 熊熊回到露台，坐下來吹吹海風。
en: Your little friend returns to the terrace and sits in the sea breeze.

zh-TW: 熊熊走到濕沙上，浪花輕輕漫過腳邊。
en: Your little friend reaches the wet sand as a small wave brushes their feet.

zh-TW: 浪退了，沙上露出一枚淡粉色的扇貝殼。
en: The wave slips away, leaving a pale pink scallop shell.

zh-TW: 熊熊帶著貝殼回到木棧道。
en: Your little friend carries the shell back to the boardwalk.

zh-TW: 熊熊走進雪松林，光影在步道上晃動。
en: Your little friend enters the cedars, where shadows dance across the trail.

zh-TW: 樹冠之間飛過一群鳥，陽光落在林間空地。
en: Birds pass between the treetops. Sunlight rests in the clearing.

zh-TW: 沿著石階走回森林入口。
en: Follow the stone steps back to the forest entrance.

zh-TW: 看著光圈慢慢放大再縮小，跟著吸氣、吐氣。
en: Watch the circle grow and soften. Breathe in, then out.

zh-TW: 熊熊坐在瑜伽墊旁，玻璃門外的葉影慢慢晃過。
en: Your little friend sits by a yoga mat as leaf shadows move beyond the glass.

zh-TW: 看海水與沙灘之間留下的紋理。
en: Notice the patterns left between the sea and sand.
Notice the light and shade along the hillside path.

zh-TW: 天空還亮著，岸上的燈已經亮了。
en: The sky is still light, while lamps glow along the shore.

zh-TW: 暖燈亮起，第一格展出玫瑰色手袋。
en: Warm lights reveal a rose-coloured handbag in the first display.

zh-TW: 轉到第二格：深色晚宴包配上金色提把。
en: The next display holds a dark evening bag with a golden handle.

zh-TW: 你們整理出大家都喜歡的堅果香，做出第一款港灣特調。Hugo 在菜單角落寫下：「和島上的朋友一起調好的。」
en: You find a nutty flavour everyone loves and make the first harbour blend. Hugo writes: Mixed together with our island friends.

zh-TW: 新飲品裝進好拿的外帶杯，配上三分鐘就能取走的早餐。Hugo 站在門口，記住了第一批晨間客人的名字。
en: The new drink comes in an easy takeaway cup with a quick breakfast. Hugo remembers the names of the first morning guests.
A Chair for Taking Your Time

zh-TW: 窗邊多了一杯可以慢慢喝的咖啡。Hugo 把最後一張桌子留給不趕時間的人，你們一起看港口的燈亮起。
en: A slow coffee waits by the window. Hugo leaves the last table for someone with nowhere to rush, and you watch the harbour lights come on.

zh-TW: 第一場沒有壓力的練球日
en: A First Practice Day without Pressure

zh-TW: 把一籃球放在練習墊旁：「有個朋友第一次來，他說怕拖累大家。你想怎麼安排今天？」
en: sets a basket of balls by the mat. A friend is visiting for the first time and worries about slowing us down. What shall we do today?

zh-TW: 你想替第一次來的朋友安排什麼開場？
en: How Shall You Welcome a First-time Friend?

zh-TW: 第一球沒到目標，第二球落在附近，大家已經開始歡呼。Liv 問你：「下一段要不要換個玩法？」
en: The first ball falls short; the second lands nearby, and everyone cheers. Liv asks whether you would like another little game.

zh-TW: 兩人合作，累積命中次數
en: Work Together and Count Your Hits

zh-TW: 每人選一個自己的小目標
有人講打空，有人講忘了帶手套。剛才最緊張的朋友終於笑了：「原來你們也會這樣。」
en: Someone mentions missing the ball, someone forgetting their glove. The nervous new friend laughs. So it happens to you too.

zh-TW: 怎麼把這份輕鬆帶到練習裡？
en: How Can You Keep Practice Feeling This Easy?
Take Turns Cheering Each Other On

zh-TW: 大家一起練一組半揮桿
en: Try a Set of Half Swings Together

zh-TW: 合作挑戰結束，大家忘了比分，卻記得第一次一起歡呼的聲音。Liv 在球社筆記裡，把這天寫成「誰都可以加入的一場」。
en: You forget the score but remember your first shared cheer. Liv calls this a practice day where anyone can join.

zh-TW: 有人第一次把球打高，有人完成五次穩定擊球。Liv 替每個人留下一句自己的進步，沒有人需要和別人比。
en: One person gets the ball into the air; another makes five steady shots. Liv records each person's own progress. No comparisons needed.

zh-TW: 每個人都輪到一次主角。最後一位新朋友收好球桿時說，下次想再帶朋友來。Liv 把下一場的空位留給了他們。
en: Everyone gets a moment in the spotlight. As the new friend puts their clubs away, they ask to bring someone next time. Liv keeps two places open.

zh-TW: 你們放慢節奏，看球桿碰到球的那一瞬間。最後一球穩穩飛起，Liv 說：「這個感覺，下次可以再一起找。」
en: You slow down and watch the club meet the ball. The final shot rises steadily. Liv smiles: We can find that feeling together next time.

zh-TW: 把今天的港城裝進一張照片
帶著相機在碼頭等你：「我想留一張今天的港城。要從人們的故事，還是光線開始找？」
en: waits by the dock with a camera. I want to keep a picture of the harbour today. Shall we begin with people's stories, or the light?

zh-TW: 夕陽在窗邊留下一道金色，港口的水面也亮起來。Ari 舉起相機，又放下：「我們還缺一個選擇。」
en: Gold falls across a window and the harbour brightens. Ari lifts the camera, then lowers it. One choice remains.
Wait for Someone to Walk into the Light

zh-TW: 你們聽見新店開張、第一次登島和剛結束的一場球。Ari 說：「這些小事，好像都住在同一座港口裡。」
en: You hear about a new shop, a first arrival, and a game just finished. Ari notices how all these little moments share one harbour.
How Shall You Bring It Together?

zh-TW: 為願意入鏡的人拍合照
en: Take a Group Photo with Those Who Want One

zh-TW: 拍下他們手邊的一件物品
有人提著晚餐經過，剛好踏進那束金色。Ari 讓對方看過照片，得到同意後，替作品取名「回家的路」。
en: Someone carries dinner home and steps into the golden light. Ari shows them the photograph and, with permission, names it The Way Home.

zh-TW: 你們沒有急著按快門。等風把窗簾吹起，一張安靜的港城照片就完成了。Ari 說，希望每個看見它的人都能喘一口氣。
en: You wait for the breeze to lift a curtain, and a quiet harbour photograph is complete. Ari hopes it gives everyone who sees it room to breathe.

zh-TW: 願意入鏡的島民站到碼頭旁，Ari 記下每個人的名字。照片裡有人眨眼，大家卻都喜歡這一張。
en: Willing neighbours gather at the dock. Ari writes down each name. Someone blinks, yet everyone loves this photo.

zh-TW: 咖啡杯、球袋和剛買的花，各自說了一小段今天。Ari 把照片排在一起，讓日常也有了被好好收藏的位置。
en: A coffee cup, a golf bag, and fresh flowers each tell a little of today. Ari arranges the pictures to give everyday life a place to be treasured.

zh-TW: 走一走，看看今天的小屋有什麼不一樣。
en: Wander a little and see what feels different at home today.

zh-TW: 讀幾頁就好，喜歡的句子可以慢慢留著。
en: Just a few pages. Keep a favourite sentence with you.

zh-TW: 這一口咖啡，想留給不趕時間的自己。
en: A sip of coffee for the part of you that does not need to hurry.

zh-TW: 今天只練輕輕一推，不急著追求完美。
en: One gentle putt today. There is no rush to be perfect.

zh-TW: 在自己的角落，什麼都不做也很舒服。
en: It feels lovely to do nothing in a corner of your own.

zh-TW: 這束花讓小屋多了一點今天的顏色。
en: A few flowers bring today's colour into the cottage.

zh-TW: 熊熊正在座位上休息，隨時可以點「起身」。
en: Your little friend is resting in a chair. Choose Stand Up anytime.

zh-TW: 熊熊正在睡覺，隨時可以點「起床」。
en: Your little friend is asleep. Choose Wake Up anytime.

zh-TW: 嗨！看到你來，熊熊開心地揮揮手。
en: Hello! Your little friend is happy to see you and waves.

zh-TW: 門邊沒有通道，請先挪開附近家具。
en: The doorway is blocked. Move a nearby piece of furniture first.

zh-TW: 先擺上展示櫃，再來看看收藏。
en: Place a display cabinet first, then admire your keepsakes.

zh-TW: 先擺上書桌或桌子，就能在桌前休息。
en: Place a writing desk or table first, then pause beside it.

zh-TW: 附近暫時沒有通道，請留一點走動空間。
en: There is no clear path nearby. Leave a little walking space.

zh-TW: 先擺上一張可以坐的椅子。
en: Place a chair to sit on first.

zh-TW: 座位前方沒有通道，請留一點空間。
en: The space in front of the seat is blocked. Leave a little room.

zh-TW: 先擺上一張床，就能躺下休息。
en: Place a bed first, then lie down for a rest.

zh-TW: 床邊沒有通道，請移動床鋪或其他家具，留出一側通行。
en: There is no clear path to the bed. Move it or nearby furniture to leave one side open.
Enjoying the View by the Window

zh-TW: 正在欣賞展示櫃裡的小回憶
en: Admiring Little Memories in the Cabinet

zh-TW: 正在椅子上休息 · 隨時可以起身
en: Resting in a Chair · Stand Up Anytime

zh-TW: 正在床上安穩睡覺 · 隨時可以起床

en: Walking to the Furniture You Chose

zh-TW: 拖曳移動 · 旋轉按鈕轉向 · 方向鍵微調
en: Drag to move · Rotate with the button · Use arrows for little adjustments

zh-TW: 請先選取要複製的家具。
en: Choose a piece of furniture to duplicate first.

zh-TW: 目前沒有空位，請先挪開或收回家具。
en: There is no free space. Move or put away a piece of furniture first.

zh-TW: 目前空間不足，請先移動或收回一件家具，再加入；原布置沒有變更。
en: There is not enough room. Move or put away an item before adding this one. Your old layout is unchanged.

zh-TW: 目前沒有可復原的移動。
點選家具後可拖曳、旋轉或收回。
en: Choose furniture to drag, rotate, or put away.
This spot works. Let go to place it.

zh-TW: 叩叩！Hugo 帶著兩小包咖啡來了。「今天想找個地方試新口味，可以進來坐坐嗎？」
en: Knock, knock! Hugo brings two little bags of coffee. May I come in and try a new flavour with you?
Show Hugo around Your Cottage First

zh-TW: 你們把杯子排好。Hugo 說這款咖啡讓他想到雨後的港口。
en: You line up the cups. Hugo says this coffee reminds him of the harbour after rain.

zh-TW: 看著你挑的色彩：「原來每個角落都能說一個故事。」
en: looks at your chosen colours. Every corner can tell a story.
What Would You Like to Talk About?

zh-TW: 這間小屋最喜歡的角落

en: A Friend to Invite Next Time

zh-TW: 把「慢慢醒來」寫在包裝上，留了一包給你的下一個早晨。
en: writes Wake Slowly on the packet and leaves a bag for your next morning.

zh-TW: 你們決定把這款咖啡留給不趕時間的人。Hugo 說下次要帶餅乾來。
en: You keep this coffee for people with time to linger. Hugo promises to bring biscuits next time.

zh-TW: 畫下你的小屋角落。「下次在店裡，也留一個這樣的位置吧。」
en: sketches your cottage corner. Perhaps the café needs a little spot like this too.

zh-TW: 你們一起列出下一場小聚的名單。小屋好像又多了一點期待。
en: You make a little guest list together. The cottage feels full of something to look forward to.
A Visit with a Golf Bag

zh-TW: 叩叩！Liv 背著小球袋站在門口。「剛練完球，要不要一起放鬆一下？」
en: Knock, knock! Liv is at the door with a little golf bag. Just finished practice. Fancy a little rest together?

zh-TW: 今天想陪 Liv 做什麼？
en: What Would You Like to Do with Liv?

zh-TW: 泡杯茶，聊聊今天的練習
en: Make Tea and Talk about Practice

zh-TW: 在空地放好小目標。「不用比遠，只要慢慢推過去。」
en: sets a small target in the open space. No need to hit far. Just roll it over gently.
How Would You Like to Play?

zh-TW: 合作，兩人一起累積三次命中
笑著說自己今天也打了好多顆歪球。「不過有一球，手感特別好。」
en: laughs about all today's wayward shots. But one of them felt just right.
What Shall You Talk About Next?

zh-TW: 今天最好玩的一個瞬間
第三次命中時，你們一起歡呼。Liv 說合作比算分有趣多了。
en: You cheer at the third hit. Liv says working together is much more fun than keeping score.

zh-TW: 球停在目標旁邊，剛剛好。Liv 把這一球叫作「不著急」。
en: The ball stops beside the target, just right. Liv names this shot No Hurry.

zh-TW: 你們交換今天最開心的小事，才發現值得記住的遠比失誤多。
en: You trade the happiest parts of today and realise there is much more to remember than mistakes.

zh-TW: 你們約好下次先熱身，再各自選一個小目標。期待被留在了這間小屋。
en: Next time, you will warm up and choose a little goal each. The cottage keeps that lovely anticipation.
The Next Page of a Travel Album

zh-TW: 叩叩！Ari 帶著一疊旅行相片。「我在整理港城的回憶，想聽聽你會怎麼選。」
en: Knock, knock! Ari brings a stack of travel photos. I am sorting harbour memories. I would love to hear what you would choose.
Which Stack Shall You Open First?
Scenery You Did Not Plan For

zh-TW: 一張相片裡，兩位陌生人在碼頭交換便當。Ari 還記得那天的笑聲。
en: In one picture, two strangers exchange lunchboxes at the dock. Ari still remembers their laughter.
What Shall You Write on the Back?

zh-TW: 有人分享，旅程就不孤單
en: A Shared Journey Is Less Lonely
Next Time, I'll Say Hello First

zh-TW: 雨讓原本的路線取消，卻帶 Ari 走進一間小書店。
en: Rain cancelled the planned route but led Ari into a little bookshop.
Leave a Little Room for Chance

zh-TW: 找一個喜歡的角落慢慢看
en: Take Your Time in a Favourite Corner

zh-TW: 把你寫的字夾進相簿。「這頁要留給路上遇見的人。」
en: tucks your words into the album. This page is for the people we meet along the way.

zh-TW: 你們約好下次在島上遇見新面孔，先說一聲嗨。
en: You promise to say hello first when a new face arrives on the island.

zh-TW: 一張沒有排進行程的風景，被你們選成了封面。
en: A scene that was never in the itinerary becomes your cover photograph.

zh-TW: 留下一張書店相片。你的小屋也像旅途中可以歇腳的角落。
en: keeps a picture of a bookshop. Your cottage feels like somewhere to rest along a journey too.

zh-TW: 碼頭搭起了小攤位。Hugo 想把這週的市集辦成一場小小的相遇，邀你一起準備。
en: Little stalls appear at the dock. Hugo hopes this week's market will bring people together and invites you to help.
Which Stall Would You Like to Run?

zh-TW: 一位居民帶著空白明信片走來，想換一個今天值得記住的瞬間。
en: A neighbour arrives with a blank postcard and asks for a moment worth keeping from today.
What Would You Invite Everyone to Share?

zh-TW: 一個還沒實現的小願望
en: A Little Wish Still to Come True

zh-TW: 桌上有貝殼、書籤和一張舊車票，每件小物都有自己的旅程。
en: A shell, a bookmark, and an old train ticket sit on the table. Each has travelled a little way.
What Would You Add to the Stall?

zh-TW: 留一句話給下一位主人
en: Leave a Line for Its Next Owner

zh-TW: 一張張小願望被帶回家，市集留下的不只是咖啡香。
en: People carry their little wishes home. More than coffee lingers after the market.

zh-TW: 每件小物都找到了願意聽故事的新主人。
en: Every little treasure finds a new owner who wants to hear its story.

zh-TW: 你們在包裝裡放進一句祝福，讓故事繼續旅行。
en: You tuck a kind wish into each parcel and let the stories travel on.

zh-TW: 今晚的島上故事是觀星小聚。Ari 邀大家帶著毯子，到港口想像一片沒有城市燈光的星空。
en: Tonight's fictional gathering is for stargazing. Ari invites everyone to bring a blanket and imagine a sky away from city lights.
A Little Star Card for Everyone

zh-TW: 拿出兩種空白卡片：「今晚想留住什麼？」
en: takes out two blank cards. What would you like to keep from tonight?
A Note to My Future Self
A Note to Someone on My Mind

zh-TW: 杯子在大家手中傳遞，夜晚慢了下來。
en: Cups pass from hand to hand, and the evening slows down.

zh-TW: 今年最想感謝的一件事
en: Something You Feel Thankful for This Year

zh-TW: 下一次想一起去的地方
en: Somewhere to Go Together Next Time

zh-TW: 你把想說的話折進星空卡，留給未來某個需要鼓勵的自己。
en: You fold a message into a star card for a future day when you might need a little kindness.

zh-TW: 那個名字被輕輕寫在卡片上，今晚多了一份溫柔的牽掛。
en: You write the name gently on the card. Tonight holds a little more tenderness.

zh-TW: 每個人的小小感謝，讓這個夜晚亮了起來。
en: Everyone's little thanks make the evening brighter.

zh-TW: 你們把下一段旅程說給星空聽，期待成了今晚的紀念。
en: You share your next journey with the stars. Anticipation becomes tonight's keepsake.

zh-TW: 一只沒有署名的小布包落在碼頭長椅上。Liv 想在天黑前找到主人，邀你加入失物小隊。
en: An unmarked cloth bag rests on a dock bench. Liv hopes to find its owner before dark and invites you to help.
Look for Clues on the Bag

zh-TW: 咖啡攤老闆說，剛才有位旅人一路拍攝港口的老招牌。
en: The coffee stallholder remembers a traveller photographing the harbour's old signs.

zh-TW: 請老闆幫忙留下尋物訊息
en: Ask the Stallholder to Leave a Message

zh-TW: 布包外側掛著一枚紙製書籤，上面畫著港口的書店。
en: A paper bookmark hangs from the bag, with a drawing of the harbour bookshop.
What Would You Like to Do?

zh-TW: 和 Liv 到書店問問
en: Ask at the Bookshop with Liv

zh-TW: 在碼頭服務台留下線索
en: Leave the Clue at the Dock Desk

zh-TW: 你們在老招牌旁找到焦急的旅人。布包裡原來裝著寫給家人的明信片。
en: You find the worried traveller by an old sign. Their bag holds postcards for family.

zh-TW: 老闆幫忙傳話，旅人很快回到碼頭領回布包。幫忙的人比想像中多。
en: The stallholder passes on the message, and the traveller soon returns. More neighbours helped than you expected.

zh-TW: 書店老闆認出了書籤，陪你們把布包送回主人手中。
en: The bookseller recognises the bookmark and helps return the bag to its owner.

zh-TW: 服務台替布包做好登記，旅人回來時，終於鬆了一口氣。
en: The desk records the bag carefully. When the traveller returns, they can finally relax.

zh-TW: 請使用有效的家具位置與角度。
en: Choose a valid furniture position and rotation.

zh-TW: 這裡放著相簿，請留一點空間。
en: Leave a little room for the photo album here.

zh-TW: 家具重疊了，請留一點空間。
en: The furniture overlaps. Leave a little space.

zh-TW: 還沒掛上營業牌，正對著兩杯咖啡發呆。「今天想先替自己挑一杯，要幫我選嗎？」
en: has not put up the open sign yet and is looking at two cups. I would like to choose one for myself first. Will you help?

zh-TW: 捧著奶咖笑了。「先照顧好自己，才有力氣迎接大家。」
en: smiles over the milky coffee. Looking after myself gives me a little more to share with everyone.

zh-TW: 打開窗，讓海風和咖啡香一起進來。「今天也慢慢開始吧。」
en: opens the window to the breeze and coffee scent. A slow beginning is lovely today too.

zh-TW: 你在旅行港遇見沒穿工作圍裙的 Hugo。他拿著一本空白筆記本：「店裡太忙，反而忘了想喝什麼。」
en: You meet Hugo without a work apron. A blank notebook rests in his hands. The café was so busy, I forgot what I felt like drinking.

zh-TW: 記一個下次想試的新口味
en: Note a New Flavour to Try

zh-TW: 你們畫出兩種完全不同的藍色。Hugo 把這頁叫作「休息也是正事」。
en: You draw two entirely different blues. Hugo names the page Rest Matters Too.

zh-TW: 在筆記本寫下柑橘與蜂蜜。「下次來店裡，也許就喝得到。」
en: writes down citrus and honey. Perhaps you will taste it next time you visit.

zh-TW: 最後一位客人離開了，Hugo 正把椅子倒扣上桌。「你覺得，今天要怎麼收尾才好？」
en: The last guest has left. Hugo turns chairs onto tables. How shall we finish the day?

zh-TW: 留下今天最好的一句話
把最喜歡的杯子擦乾淨
把「謝謝你今天也來了」貼在櫃檯邊。這是只在打烊後看得到的留言。
en: puts Thank You for Coming Today beside the counter, a note only seen after closing.

zh-TW: 杯子在燈下亮了一點，Hugo 說明天想把它留給第一位來客。
en: The cup gleams beneath the lamp. Hugo would like to save it for tomorrow's first guest.
By the Night Lamp in Banyan Square

zh-TW: 仰頭看著夜燈。「其實我一直想開一間，不點咖啡也能坐一會兒的店。」
en: looks up at the lamp. I have always wanted a café where you could sit awhile without ordering coffee.

zh-TW: 那就先留一張不用消費的椅子
en: Start with One Chair That Needs No Purchase

zh-TW: 替這個願望寫一張小卡
en: Write the Wish on a Little Card

zh-TW: 點點頭。「不必一下子做到全部，先從一張椅子開始。」
en: nods. I do not have to do it all at once. One chair is enough to begin.

zh-TW: 你們寫下「給想歇腳的人」。Hugo 小心地把卡片放進口袋。
en: You write For Anyone Who Needs a Rest. Hugo tucks the card into a pocket.
The First Ball Has No Score

zh-TW: 只有一籃球，卻沒急著揮桿。「今天第一球，我想試試不算距離。」
en: has one basket of balls but no hurry to swing. For today's first ball, I would like to forget the distance.

zh-TW: 球飛得不遠，但 Liv 說這次握桿沒有那麼緊了。
en: The ball does not go far, but Liv says the grip feels a little more relaxed.

zh-TW: 你們先活動肩膀，笑說熱身也可以算今天的一個小勝利。
en: You loosen your shoulders and laugh. Warming up counts as a little win too.

zh-TW: 把球袋留在球場，走到海邊。「有時候一直練，反而忘了怎麼放鬆。」
en: leaves the golf bag behind and walks to the sea. Sometimes practising all the time makes me forget how to rest.
Listen to the Waves for a Minute

zh-TW: 找一片形狀特別的葉子
你們沒有急著說話。Liv 說，下次揮桿前也想記得這種節奏。
en: You do not rush to speak. Liv would like to remember this rhythm before the next swing.

zh-TW: 撿起一片彎彎的葉子。「原來不完美的形狀，也很有意思。」
en: picks up a curved leaf. Even an imperfect shape can be interesting.
The Last Lamp on Sports Island

zh-TW: 燈快熄了，Liv 蹲在練習墊邊。「這球不進也沒關係，你要幫它取個名字嗎？」
en: The lights are nearly out. Liv crouches by the mat. It need not go in. Shall we give this ball a name?
Call It See You Next Time

zh-TW: 球停在洞口旁。Liv 收起球桿：「好，今天到這裡。」
en: The ball stops by the hole. Liv puts the club away. Enough for today, then.

zh-TW: 把球放回袋子。「那就把期待留給下一次。」
en: puts the ball back in the bag. We can leave something to look forward to next time.
A Quiet Lane by Tide Market

zh-TW: 看著遠處的燈。「我以前總覺得，要比別人打得好，才算喜歡這件事。」
en: looks toward the lights. I used to think I had to play better than someone else to prove I loved it.

zh-TW: 分享一件只為自己做的小事
en: Share Something You Do Just for Yourself

zh-TW: 她想了一下：「現在喜歡的，是球飛出去那一下的感覺。」
en: She thinks awhile. Now, I love the feeling when the ball leaves the club.

zh-TW: 你們交換了兩件不需要成績證明的小事。這條夜路變得輕了一點。
en: You trade little joys that need no score to prove their worth. The evening path feels lighter.

zh-TW: 正收起相機。「每次出發前，我都會留一張不拍自己的照片。今天要拍什麼？」
en: puts away the camera. Before leaving, I always keep one photograph without myself in it. What shall it be today?
A Boat Not Yet Leaving Shore
An Empty Bench Waiting for a Friend

zh-TW: 說這張照片裡，裝的是還沒發生的故事。
en: says the photograph holds stories that have not happened yet.

zh-TW: 留下長椅旁的一角陽光。「也許下一次回來，這裡會坐著新朋友。」
en: keeps a corner of sunlight by the bench. Perhaps a new friend will be sitting here next time.
In the Shade on Café Street

zh-TW: 坐在樹蔭下整理車票。「今天本來排滿了行程，但我決定少去一個地方。」
en: sorts tickets beneath a tree. Today was full of plans, but I chose to visit one place less.

zh-TW: 留時間看一個地方久一點
en: Leave More Time for One Place

zh-TW: 把空白留給偶然的相遇
en: Keep Some Space for a Chance Meeting

zh-TW: 你們在同一棵樹下，看見光影換了好幾次形狀。
en: Beneath the same tree, you watch the light change shape again and again.

zh-TW: 一位路過的居民推薦了小書店。Ari 在地圖上添了一個沒有時間表的圓圈。
en: A passing neighbour recommends a little bookshop. Ari adds a circle with no timetable to the map.
By the Tide Line at Travel Harbour
An Empty Bottle by the Sea

zh-TW: 在潮線邊找到一只乾淨的空瓶。「如果一段故事可以漂到別人手上，你想送出什麼？」
en: finds a clean bottle at the tide line. If a story could drift into someone else's hands, what would you send?
A Kind Word for a Stranger

zh-TW: 一個還沒完成的小願望
把瓶口朝向海面。「一句話很小，但也許剛好有人需要。」
en: turns the bottle toward the sea. One line is small, but it may be just what someone needs.

zh-TW: 說，願望被別人接住時，也許會長出新的形狀。
en: says a wish might find a new shape when someone else receives it.
A View for Your Future Self

zh-TW: 正在夜景旁寫明信片。「這張不寄給別人，我想寄給未來的自己。」
en: writes a postcard beside the night view. This one is for my future self, rather than someone else.

zh-TW: 提醒自己還有很多地方能去
en: Remember There Is More to Explore

zh-TW: 提醒自己也可以選擇留下
en: Remember You Can Choose to Stay Too

zh-TW: 寫下：「別忘了，你還有很多好奇。」
en: writes: Do not forget how curious you still are.

zh-TW: 寫下：「停下來，也是一種抵達。」
en: writes: Stopping is a kind of arrival too.
A Kind Word for a Stranger

zh-TW: 海風帶來一句話：今天也辛苦了。
en: The breeze brings a little line: You have done enough today.

zh-TW: 下一站，有人替疲憊的旅人留了一張椅子。
en: At the next shore, someone leaves a chair for a tired traveller.

zh-TW: 一杯溫熱的茶，讓這段路慢了下來。
en: A cup of warm tea slows the journey down.

zh-TW: 故事還沒結束，希望下一位也能被溫柔接住。
en: The story is not over. May the next traveller find some kindness too.

zh-TW: 一張沒有目的地的船票，躺在瓶子裡。
en: A boat ticket with no destination rests inside the bottle.

zh-TW: 沿著海邊的小路，大家發現一座沒見過的橋。
en: Along the coastal path, everyone discovers an unfamiliar bridge.

zh-TW: 橋的另一端，有人畫了一張新的地圖。
en: Beyond the bridge, someone has drawn a new map.

zh-TW: 地圖留著一塊空白，等下一位旅人添上風景。
en: The map keeps a blank corner for the next traveller's scenery.

zh-TW: 有人把一個還沒說出口的小願望放進瓶裡。
en: Someone puts a small, unspoken wish inside the bottle.

zh-TW: 一位島民替它畫上星星，說不妨先試一小步。
en: A neighbour draws a star beside it and suggests one small step.

zh-TW: 這一小步，意外遇見了願意同行的朋友。
en: That little step leads unexpectedly to a friend willing to come along.

zh-TW: 大家把新的期待交給海風，讓願望繼續旅行。
en: Everyone gives their hopes to the breeze and lets the wish travel on.
A Gentle Walk along the Path

zh-TW: 運動公園：草地、果嶺、伸展平台與休息座椅
en: Sports Park: lawn, putting green, stretching deck, and rest seats

zh-TW: 旅人車站：站房、時鐘、月台、行李與明信片牆
en: Travellers' Station: station house, decorative clock, platform, luggage, and postcards

zh-TW: 到果嶺推一球、伸展一下，或探索其他運動設施。
en: Try a putt, stretch a little, or explore another sports facility.

zh-TW: 下一班車還沒到，先翻張明信片，看看路上的風景。
en: Before the next train arrives, open a postcard and enjoy a scene from the road.

zh-TW: 今天不比遠，也不比快。我剛繞了一圈步道，你想去果嶺試一球嗎？
en: No distance or speed to beat today. I just walked the path. Would you like a gentle putt?

zh-TW: 我收集的不是打卡地點，是路上讓我停下來的小事。這裡有幾張明信片，送你一段風景。
en: I collect the little things that make me pause, rather than a list of places. Here are some postcards with a view for you.

zh-TW: 面向海風的練習果嶺。調整方向與力道，讓球慢慢滾向旗桿。
en: A practice green facing the sea breeze. Set the direction and power and let the ball roll gently toward the flag.

zh-TW: 翻開一張旅人的明信片，不用考試，也不用練英文。
en: Open a traveller's postcard. There is no test and no language practice to finish.

zh-TW: 木平台朝向海風。手臂放鬆，留意呼吸，想休息就坐一會。
en: The wooden deck faces the breeze. Let your arms soften, notice your breathing, and sit whenever you like.

zh-TW: 車站時鐘慢慢走，花圃旁有空位。旅行可以從身邊的一段小路開始。
en: The station has a decorative clock and room to pause by the flowers. A journey can begin on a nearby path.

zh-TW: 揮了揮手：「一起慢慢逛，不用急著完成什麼。」
en: waves. Let's wander slowly. There is nothing you have to finish.

zh-TW: 笑著說：「祝你在下一段路，也能遇見喜歡的小事。」
en: smiles. May the next part of your journey hold little things you love too.

zh-TW: 清晨的小站只開了一盞燈。麵包店的香氣比列車早到，我決定晚一班再出發。
en: One lamp glowed at the morning station. Bread arrived before the train, so I chose to leave a little later.

zh-TW: 海邊的長椅還帶著雨。我把傘放在旁邊，陪一隻不怕生的小貓等天晴。
en: The seaside bench was still damp. I put my umbrella beside it and waited for sunshine with a friendly little cat.

zh-TW: 那座城市沒有留下很多照片，但我記得有人替我指路時，笑著說的那句「慢慢來」。
en: I kept few photographs of that city, but I remember someone smiling as they showed me the way and said, Take your time.

zh-TW: 你讀完了一張旅人明信片。
en: You have read a traveller's postcard.

zh-TW: 肩膀輕輕放下，手臂伸展，再慢慢鬆開。這次休息完成。
en: Let your shoulders soften, stretch your arms, then release them slowly. A little rest, complete.

zh-TW: 你在長椅坐了一會。下一班車還沒來，也沒關係。
en: You sat awhile on the bench. The next train is not here yet, and that is all right.

zh-TW: 木質器材室 · 跑步體驗
雙人球桌 · 擊球示意
en: A Table for Two · Movement Preview

zh-TW: 海風球場 · 擊球示意
綠色球場 · 擊球示意
面海水池 · 入水放鬆
設施第一版 · 可查看場景與簡單動作示意，球場尚未開放完整對打。
en: First facility edition: explore scenes and simple movement previews. Full matches are not available yet.

zh-TW: 你坐上面海長椅，腳步停下，看看海風。
en: You settle onto the sea-facing bench and let your feet rest.

zh-TW: 你起身伸個懶腰，想散步時再出發。
en: You stand and stretch gently. Wander whenever you are ready.

zh-TW: 坐在長椅上，讓海風陪你休息。
en: Rest on the bench with the sea breeze for company.

zh-TW: 已經起身，沿著木棧道慢慢走。
en: You are standing again. Take your time along the boardwalk.

zh-TW: 面海的無邊際水池。這一版提供短暫入水的動作示意。
en: A sea-facing infinity pool. This edition offers a short dip animation.

zh-TW: 先試試跑步機，隨時可以離開。這一版是器材動作雛形。
en: Try the treadmill and leave whenever you like. This is a first equipment movement preview.

zh-TW: 這一版先提供球場與擊球示意，尚未開放完整對打或多人連線。
en: This edition offers court scenes and movement previews. Full matches and multiplayer are not available yet.

zh-TW: 熊熊輕輕入水，漂浮一會。
en: Your little friend slips into the water and floats awhile.
Your little friend begins a movement preview…

zh-TW: 這次體驗完成，可以再試一次。
en: A little try, complete. Feel free to do it again.

zh-TW: 連貫的海岸渡假村：碼頭、生活街、運動俱樂部、小屋與自然步道
en: One coastal retreat: dock, living street, sports club, cottages, and nature paths

zh-TW: 有門牌、信箱與小花園的自家門前
en: Your front door, with a nameplate, mailbox, and little garden

zh-TW: 想念可以先留在這裡。你不需要現在就替這份感情找到答案。
en: You can leave that feeling of missing someone here. You do not need an answer for it right now.

zh-TW: 這份委屈，我們先輕輕放下。不用急著解釋，也不用證明自己值得被理解。
en: Let us set that hurt down gently. You do not need to explain it or prove you deserve to be understood.

zh-TW: 今天撐到這裡，已經花了不少力氣。現在可以先不做什麼。
en: It took effort to get this far today. For now, you can simply rest.

zh-TW: 說不清楚也沒關係。你可以帶著現在的樣子，在這裡停一會。
en: It is all right if you cannot put it into words. Stay awhile, just as you are.

zh-TW: 傷心不需要立刻消失，這座島會先替你保管。
en: Sadness does not have to leave straight away. This island can hold it for a little while.

zh-TW: 想念、委屈、疲憊，或只是想找個地方停一會，都可以。
en: Missing someone, feeling hurt or tired, or simply needing somewhere to pause: all are welcome here.

zh-TW: 傷心之島，可以點地面或用方向鍵散步
en: Quiet Island. Tap the ground or use arrow keys to wander.

zh-TW: 點地面散步 · 方向鍵也可以
en: Tap the Ground to Wander · Or Use Arrow Keys

zh-TW: 傷心雲朵 · 月光淨化樹 · 海邊長椅 · 擁抱玩偶
en: Rain Cloud · Moonlit Tree · Seaside Bench · Cuddly Toy
Let the Island Hold This Feeling

zh-TW: 現在，比較像哪一種心情？
en: Which Feeling Is Closest Right Now?

zh-TW: 想說一點什麼嗎？（可略過）
en: Would You Like to Write a Little? (Optional)

zh-TW: 不用整理好，也可以什麼都不寫。
en: It need not be tidy. You can leave this blank too.

zh-TW: 文字只留在當次頁面，交給小島或離開後即清空。不儲存、不公開、不傳送給 AI。
en: Your words stay on this page only and clear when you leave or let them go. They are not saved, shared, or sent to AI.
Let the Island Hold My Sadness

zh-TW: 不用打卡，也不必等心情變好才離開。
en: No daily check-in, and no need to feel better before leaving.

zh-TW: 開啟 JavaScript 後，就能使用心情互動。你也可以直接留在這裡看海，或隨時離島。
en: Enable JavaScript to use the mood interaction, or simply stay and watch the sea. Leave whenever you like.

zh-TW: 再把一點心事交給小島
en: Let the Island Hold a Little More

zh-TW: 小島正在接住這一刻。你可以慢慢呼吸，也可以隨時離開。
en: The island is holding this moment. Breathe slowly, or leave whenever you like.

zh-TW: 這張長椅沒有時間限制。想安靜待著，或隨時起身，都可以。
en: There is no time limit on this bench. Stay quietly or stand whenever you like.
